reference_uncertainty.interpretation: Evaluator-assigned envelope, not a rigorous experimental confidence interval. Section 1.2 uses approximate standard-deviation language; Section 2.6 describes a two-sigma coverage objective. Neither supplies an exact probability model.

limitations: Historical JPL Evaluation 17 is the frozen development source, not a claim to be the latest evaluation.
B1 considers measurements and theoretical work and bases its recommendation on the cited Sellevag study; this is not an independent experimentally measured high-pressure point.
The source uses air for its third-body recommendation and warns of a large water-vapor collider effect; do not substitute a humid-gas or another bath-gas finite-pressure experiment.
No finite pressure, falloff trajectory, lifetime, branching fraction, elementary mechanism ground truth or complete experimental uncertainty is frozen here.
No execution budget is granted, no spin-coupled entrance surface is selected, and no applicable capture or master-equation provider has been established by this reference.
No acceptance threshold, prospective holdout, independent-data count, method support or STORCA uncertainty calibration is admitted.
